subject.title: Flaky tests on Windows/WSL: timeouts and ENOENT in pi-tools workspace-paths & safe-bins

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90273 stop claiming to close this issue, and should maintainers request a fresh WSL reproduction before sponsoring a Pi-tools test repair?
rationale: The linked PR's actual scope does not cover the reported tests, while current-main reproduction has not been established; a maintainer must decide whether to correct the relationship and prioritize renewed platform evidence.

options.title: Correct linkage and reproduce
options.body: Remove or correct the hardlink PR's closing reference, then obtain a focused WSL run of the two Pi-tools suites before choosing a repair.

options.title: Treat as no longer actionable
options.body: Close only after maintainers obtain evidence that current supported WSL runs no longer reproduce either reported failure.

recommendation.title: Correct linkage and reproduce
recommendation.body: Remove or correct the hardlink PR's closing reference, then obtain a focused WSL run of the two Pi-tools suites before choosing a repair.
